    static JsonTypeInfo CreateList<T>(JsonSerializerOptions options)
    {
        var elem = ResolveElement<T>(options);
        if (elem is null) return null;
        return JsonMetadataServices.CreateListInfo<List<T>, T>(
            options,
            new JsonCollectionInfoValues<List<T>>
            {
                ObjectCreator = static () => new List<T>(),
                ElementInfo = elem
            });
    }

    static JsonTypeInfo CreateArray<T>(JsonSerializerOptions options)
    {
        var elem = ResolveElement<T>(options);
        if (elem is null) return null;
        return JsonMetadataServices.CreateArrayInfo<T>(
            options,
            new JsonCollectionInfoValues<T[]>
            {
                ElementInfo = elem
            });
    }

    static JsonTypeInfo<T> ResolveElement<T>(JsonSerializerOptions options)
    {
        try { return options.GetTypeInfo(typeof(T)) as JsonTypeInfo<T>; }
        catch (System.InvalidOperationException) { return null; }
    }

    sealed class NullableEnumConverter<T> : global::System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter<T?> where T : struct, System.Enum
    {
        readonly global::System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter<T> inner;
        public NullableEnumConverter(global::System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonConverter<T> inner) => this.inner = inner;

        public override T? Read(ref global::System.Text.Json.Utf8JsonReader reader, Type typeToConvert, JsonSerializerOptions options)
        {
            if (reader.TokenType == global::System.Text.Json.JsonTokenType.Null) return null;
            return this.inner.Read(ref reader, typeof(T), options);
        }

        public override void Write(global::System.Text.Json.Utf8JsonWriter writer, T? value, JsonSerializerOptions options)
        {
            if (value is null) { writer.WriteNullValue(); return; }
            this.inner.Write(writer, value.Value, options);
        }
    }
